notes:
Summary: BayBridge CustodiaLex is a mid-market SaaS that provides a hosted KB + chat layer to enterprise customers (customer support, legal ops). They ingest customer KBs (help articles, chat transcripts, policies). Looking for a hosted inference partner for embeddings + reranking to improve relevancy and support high QPS traffic.

Key ask (verbatim): "We need 300 QPS sustained with spikes to 1k and p95 rerank <150ms — and keep unit cost below $0.002/query if possible."

Indexing scale: current pilot ~800k docs (avg 500 tokens / doc); expect 2-3M doc plateau in 12 months. Prefer 1536-d embeddings or similar. Reranker: cross-encoder for final top-10 re-rank, or Redwood-suggested lightweight rerank fallback for cost.

Security: SOC2 required; SSO (SAML) + audit logs + KMS for keying. Some EU customers require data residency; default hosted region must include eu-west.

Buying motion: evaluation leads to single-year reserved commit if POC meets perf + cost. Influencers: Head of Platform (technical), VP Product (budget), Legal (data residency).

Quirks / shorthand: heavy peak traffic 10am-12pm PST, caching effective for repeated queries (support flows), will want automatic prefix/KV caching. They asked about quantized model variants for cost savings.

Decision signals: successful 2-week POC metrics (latency, 95th p95, cost per q), SOC2 artifacts, clear routing/fallback plan during capacity spikes.

AE notes: call 2026-02-10 strong. Diego to supply POC config. Next call 2026-03-02 to review perf results.

technical_requirements: Targets: sustain 300 QPS (avg query = retrieval + embed + rerank), peaks to 1k. Initial index 800k documents (~500 tokens each). Desire 1536-d embeddings, vector store with ANN latency <20ms for top-100 candidate fetch, cross-encoder rerank for final top-10. Need per-route token & latency breakdowns, and ability to pin model versions for canary. Autoscaling/burst capacity is required.
perf_targets: P50 retrieval latency <40ms, ANN fetch + embedding compute. P95 end-to-end reranked response <150ms. Cost target: blended cost per customer query <= $0.002 (includes embedding + retriever + rerank).
